headline:
Steady growth,
well off its highs
chart_note: 10-day range: $77.77 - $82.23, up 4% over the window - still roughly 36% below the 52-week high of $126.71.
why_today: Down slightly today after a 13% rally over the past month - revenue and earnings both growing double digits YoY, though the stock remains well below its 52-week high.
pro_1: Revenue up 13.4% and earnings up 11.1% YoY - consistent, not a one-quarter spike
pro_2: Analyst sentiment strongly positive (36 Buy/Strong Buy vs. 15 Hold, 0 Sell)
con_1: Still about 36% below its 52-week high - worth understanding what drove that pullback before assuming it is behind it
con_2: PEG ratio of 1.79 and RSI of 66 mean this isn't a bargain entry, even after the drawdown
